identityVerification: sourceSha is the Production application SHA supplied after external verification; runnerSha identifies the local benchmark code; the Production deployment ID and source SHA must be confirmed externally immediately before/after the run
runtime: read-only anonymous guest navigation against the public Production origin

method.cold: new isolated BrowserContext with fresh client cache and source loaded before activation; Next/server caches are not cleared and Link prefetch may populate the destination
method.warm: same context after destination, browser Back to source, then repeated activation; source reload fallback is recorded
method.start: trusted pointerdown on the actual visible semantic destination anchor
method.desktopPressDuration: Playwright holds the desktop mouse button for 50 ms before release to model a brief physical press and allow a render opportunity; the timer still starts at trusted pointerdown. Pixel 7 uses a normal trusted tap.
method.firstVisibleUi: minimum of a changed :active style, new visible loading UI, or destination H1 that is present in two consecutive requestAnimationFrame samples; the second sample is a conservative bound after a browser render opportunity, not a direct compositor timestamp
method.visibleFrameConfirmation: Each candidate must remain the same element and satisfy visibility checks across two consecutive animation-frame callbacks. Timing is recorded on the second callback, which confirms the browser had an intervening render opportunity; a one-frame or transient style-state mutation is not counted as visible feedback.
method.loadingUi: first new viewport-visible [aria-busy=true], [role=status], [data-testid*=loading], or [data-pending=true] whose computed opacity is at least 0.1; excludes screen-reader-only/clipped/pre-existing indicators
method.content: first viewport-intersecting destination H1 matching the route expectation
method.repetitions: 10 accepted cold/warm pairs per device and transition; up to 13 attempts; p95 uses nearest-rank empirical quantile
method.interactionBoundary: anonymous GET/navigation only; keyboard checks activate links with Enter; no account sign-in, Admin routes, forms, or writes
